Name: Alpacas
Author: omena007
Description:
This mod adds Alpacas as barn animals and alpaca wool and alpaca yarn as the products. Alpacas need a deluxe barn and can be bought from Marnie. You can use yarn to make candles if you use my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30597]Bees Plus[/url] mod. There's two new quests and hats.

Other mods that add alpacas are compatible.

[b][size=4]Quest Unlocking conditions and rewards:[/size][/b]

[spoiler]

Emily's quest is unlocked day after you have shipped Alpaca Wool. She gifts you with a Chullo hat.

Evelyn's quest is unlocked day after you have shipped Alpaca Yarn. She gifts you with an Alpaca beanie.

[/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/7886557-1725804964.png[/img]
The extremely cute alpaca sprites are made by Aerithay / MaggieW (I just slightly edited the animation and shadows) and you can find the original mod [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/alpaca-mod-for-sheep.3652/]here[/url] and their amazing art portfolio here: [url=https://margaretwillemsen.weebly.com/]https://margaretwillemsen.weebly.com/[/url]  The wool and yarn sprites are made by me.

The turkeys in the picture are from [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/688256-eemies-animals-for-bfav]Eemie's Animals for BFAV[/url] and the donkeys are my other mod.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/7886557-1725804929.png[/img]
